title: Javascript Hoisting
question_text: What is the output of: console.log(a); var a = 5;
explanation: Variables declared with 'var' are hoisted to the top of their scope and initialized with 'undefined'.

title: React useEffect Cleanup
question_text: When does the cleanup function in useEffect run?
options: Before every re-render and on unmount
answer: Before every re-render and on unmount
explanation: The cleanup function runs before the effect is re-executed to prevent memory leaks and on unmount.

title: Closures in JS
question_text: A function that remembers its outer variables even after the outer function has returned is called a:
explanation: A closure is the combination of a function bundled together (enclosed) with references to its surrounding state (the lexical environment).

title: CSS Flexbox Centering
question_text: Which property combo centers children in Flexbox?
explanation: Justify-content centers along the main axis, and align-items centers along the cross axis.

title: Node.js Event Loop
question_text: Which phase of the Event Loop handles setTimeout callbacks?
explanation: The Timers phase handles callbacks scheduled by setTimeout() and setInterval().
